_: PF-609 — every TTFE threshold lives HERE and nowhere else. p.6: 'Any regression past the configured threshold fails the build.' A budget that can be relaxed inside a test body is not a budget; raising one of these numbers is a reviewable diff with the number visible in it. scripts/ttfe/check-thresholds.mjs greps the lane's own files for a second literal.
_totalMs: p.8's Signature Challenge: the whole loop under 60 s in CI. Asserted per run (PF-600) and as a P95 over p95WindowRuns (PF-600, second gate).
_stageMs: Per-stage ceilings (PF-591/PF-593). These deliberately sum ABOVE totalMs: a stage budget is a diagnostic that names WHICH stage went wrong, the total is the graded gate. install carries the largest share because it is a real pnpm install of a packed tarball (PF-589), not a symlink.
_p95WindowRuns: p.9 measures flake 'over 20 consecutive CI runs'. The PRD never states a window for the < 60 s P95, so the two share one series — a convenience, not a citation (recorded in the lane file).
_p95TotalMs: The SECOND gate on p.8's < 60 s, and deliberately the same number as totalMs. The per-run assertion catches a regression on the PR that caused it; the P95 over the window catches a slow drift that never trips any individual run. Reporting one and calling it the other is the easiest way to claim this target without meeting it.
_p95EventToPostMs: p.6: 'webhook delivery latency (P95, first attempt) < 2s'. L99's U5 — no lane measured this end to end on the wire before the drill (PF-603).
_verifyLatencyMs: p.8: 'Signature verification < 1 ms'. Gated on L18's recorded benchmark over >= 1000 iterations from the SAME packed build the drill installed (PF-602). The drill's own single verify call is recorded for the trend and is explicitly NOT the gate.
_reconcileToleranceMs: PF-591: stage times plus measured inter-stage gaps must reconcile with the total to within this. Without it, five stages summing to 8 s inside a 55 s run reads as a pass.
_loadRatioVeto: L99 F80: three runs on one commit spread 6.0x under load ratio 1.33-1.88 on this hardware. Every timing this drill records carries loadAvg1/loadRatio; above this ratio the numbers are reported but not treated as certified.
_cleanModeMinutes: p.8: '<= 30 min real elapsed' on a clean machine. Belongs to --clean mode (PF-590) and to the human-timed run (PF-601) — never to the fast mode, which is why the two figures carry a `mode` field in ttfe.json.
